name: Kṛṣṇa (Vāsudeva)
summary: In BhG 13–15 Kṛṣṇa (addressed as Keśava, 13.1, and Prabhu, 14.21) teaches the field and its knower, calling himself the knower in all fields (13.3); the three guṇas, calling himself the seed-giving father and the foundation of brahman (14.4, 14.27); and the aśvattha tree and the highest person, declaring himself the puruṣottama (15.18).

name: Arjuna (Pārtha, Dhanaṃjaya)
summary: In BhG 13–15 Arjuna asks about prakṛti and puruṣa, field and knower, knowledge and the knowable (13.1, an extra verse in some editions) and about the marks, conduct and means of one gone beyond the guṇas (14.21); he is addressed as Kaunteya, Bhārata, Bharatarṣabha, Pāṇḍava, Kurunandana, Mahābāhu and Anagha.
